title: Eleven Column Inches
subtitle: 新闻报道 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 新闻报道（社会服务与人际沟通·新闻与传媒）
meta: 主题语境：新闻报道（社会服务与人际沟通·新闻与传媒）　|　核心词汇：coverage　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 coverage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 my father ① read the coverage of a fire that had burnt eleven miles away, and he said the reading was the whole of the worry. The ② coverage, meaning the reporting and not the fire, ran eleven column inches and stayed that length; coverage, he said, is the only thing in a paper that is judged by how far away it feels.

Every ③ coverage in that paper had the same photograph at the top, and the ④ coverage at the end, meaning the one he kept for the inquiry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever clipped twice. Coverage, my mother said, is nine parts photograph and one part somebody willing to clip; my father said the clipping is the part that fills eleven inches.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ coverage was the whole of the policy, meaning the protection and not the reporting. The ⑥ coverage, meaning the protection and not any of that, is the only thing in a policy that everybody pays for and nobody reads; coverage, he said, is either something you read or the only word that means both a reporting and a protection. She said the protection is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ coverage had become a line in an index, and the index had become an argument about the photograph. The ⑧ coverage of the whole thing, my father wrote in April, was one fire and thirty years of clipping; coverage, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to read. He said the reading was never mentioned.

The ⑨ coverage I remember is the one at the end, which ran in 1979 and is still described as the shortest in the county. A ⑩ coverage, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being clipped; every coverage, she said, is a protection that has agreed to look like a reporting. She said the protection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 新闻报道；报道量
B. n. 报道（指那段报道本身，与那场火灾相对）
C. 固定搭配：read the coverage of 阅读关于……的报道
D. n. 报道（指那份报纸上每一篇）
E. n. 报道（指末尾那一份）
F. n. 承保范围；保险额度
G. n. 报道（指索引里提到的那一篇）
H. n. 覆盖范围；覆盖面（抽象总称）

answers.why: read the coverage of 意为“阅读关于……的报道”，1965 年父亲读了关于一场烧到十一英里外的火灾的报道。
coverage 意为“报道”，指那段报道本身而不是那场火灾，占了十一栏英寸。
coverage 指那份报纸上每一篇报道，每一篇顶上都配着同一张照片。
coverage 指末尾那一份（他留给调查的那一份），是唯一有人剪过两次的。
coverage 意为“承保范围、保险额度”，叔叔说承保范围就是那份保单的全部，指的是保障范围而不是那段报道。
coverage 为保险用语，指保障范围而不是那段报道，是保单里人人都付钱、却无人阅读的东西。
coverage 意为“报道”，指索引里提到的那一篇，到 1973 年这篇报道成了索引里的一行。
coverage 意为“覆盖范围、覆盖面”，父亲四月写道，整件事的覆盖面是一场火灾三十年的剪报。
coverage 意为“新闻报道”，我记得的是末尾那一份，1979 年刊出，至今仍被说成全县最短的。
coverage 为抽象总称，母亲说一篇报道是唯一会因为被剪下而变好的东西。
